backend/main.mo: Defines actor with access control, storage mixins, and a large normalized category–subcategory taxonomy used by backend APIs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, and test IDs for traceability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing many frontend files, layouts, components, and configs.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme variables and dark mode color tokens using OKLCH values for global styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file mounting the React app root and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, React Query provider, and global layout with header and footer.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Protects admin pages by enforcing Internet Identity login and admin authorization with loading and denial states.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminJobPo: Admin UI for reviewing, approving, rejecting, and toggling between pending and all job posts.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminWorke: Admin UI for reviewing workers with actions for approval, rejection, verification, and featuring, with pending/all toggle.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeIconI: Image component that validates source, handles errors, and falls back to a safe icon.
frontend/src/components/i18n/BilingualTe: Displays paired regional and English text with configurable styling.
frontend/src/components/i18n/I18nProvide: Provides app-wide i18n context with fixed Tamil regional language and translation lookup.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobBoard.ts: Displays a list of approved job posts with bilingual heading and call button.
frontend/src/components/landing/FooterBa: Footer with bilingual text, contact link, and attribution including WhatsApp CTA.
frontend/src/components/landing/HeaderBa: Responsive header with navigation links, mobile menu toggle, and bilingual text support.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: Page wrapper providing consistent background, spacing, and layout variants.
frontend/src/components/workers/WorkerCa: Displays worker details with photo, bilingual labels, verified badge, and contact buttons.
Defines a list of local skilled worker subcategories with icons and bilingual labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actors, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: Provides admin mutations for approving, rejecting, verifying, and featuring workers and jobs with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, handling login, identity loading, and state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides multiple React Query hooks to fetch jobs, workers, admin status, and user profile from the backend with error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerSearch.ts: Implements a worker search hook that sanitizes inputs, queries workers by filters, validates results, and returns only approved workers.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerTaxonomy.ts: Fetches and normalizes worker categories and subcategories with fallback values and deduplication logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for a vibrant color theme and typography.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Renders the admin panel with tabs for reviewing workers and job posts, wrapped in an admin guard.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Displays a static blog listing with sample posts inside a styled PageShell.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with bilingual hero text, area search, worker categories, and navigation to search results.
frontend/src/pages/JobRequestPage.tsx: Provides a form for users to submit job requests, handling validation, backend submission, and success/error states.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerRegistrationPag: Implements a worker registration form with validation, photo upload, taxonomy selection, and backend submission.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPa: Displays searchable worker results with filters for area, category, and subcategory, updating results via router search params.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualTaxonomy.ts: Maps category, subcategory, and group strings to i18n translation keys and returns bilingual labels with fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Provides safe error message extraction and logging utilities.
frontend/src/utils/normalizeTaxonomy.ts: Offers helpers to normalize, deduplicate, and canonicalize taxonomy strings for consistent comparisons.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning hash params for routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme colors, container settings, extended styles, and plugins like typography and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the AREA WORKARS platform scope, design guidelines, known issues, and required assets.
